text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with Aston 
Machan, one corner of the shopping 
district was unusually lively.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hm, a raffle?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I will go obtain it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Here is a lottery ticket.
choice_data_list: Do you want to do it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course. A "Hot Spring Trip Voucher" 
means, well... that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A spotless inn, delicious meals, hot 
springs. Pillow fights and girl talk. Yes, 
a true treasure chest of memories.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: How could I not do it? ...No, I must.

Together with Aston Machan, I hurried to 
get raffle tickets—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Here I go!

Aston Machan enthusiastically spun the 
raffle drum lever!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Wah.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's amazing. You're incredible, 
Chan-mee...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
With this, I can invite Vodka and the 
others for a nice, cozy hot spring trip 
for the three of us—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry. This is a pair ticket, you see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? If it's pairs, then three of 
us can't go together...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: We have a problem.
choice_data_list: Why don't you put it away for now?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The day to use it will surely 
come.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In my room... no, I will leave it in the 
Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's display it. Inside a frame.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If you treasure it, you won't lose it. One 
glance is all it takes to remember.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you won't end up letting 
them go to waste. Perfect.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
First of all, I need to go buy a big 
picture frame...!

And so, until that fateful day comes, the 
"Hot Springs Trip Ticket" was put on 
display in the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Kh... Just one step away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still, it looks very delicious. And it is 
exceptionally large.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, have you decided on dinner 
yet?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...*munch*.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...! Th-This is...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes. A revolution.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is so good, we practically have to 
declare today Carrot Hamburg Steak Day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, next year is also Carrot 
Hamburg Steak Day. And the year after 
that. We will definitely eat carrot 
hamburg steaks.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And in time, it becomes tradition, 
recorded in textbooks a hundred years from 
now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The great Umamusume who created Carrot 
Hamburger Steak Day: Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Even I have to admit, that's asking too 
much. Hehe.

Chatting casually, the two of us savored 
the special carrot hamburg steak together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... I couldn't reach them.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still, a whole heaping pile of carrots... 
What should we do?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Chan and Trainer-san... With only two 
stomachs, will we be able to finish all of 
this?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is an emergency live broadcast. 
Hello, everyone. I am Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, we have a carrot incident on 
our hands. Yes... there are leftover 
carrots."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just between Trainer and Machan, we simply 
don't have enough stomach capacity.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is strictly for Tracen Academy 
students, but if there is anyone willing 
to lend a hand, I would be most grateful 
for your help.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Any girls who are interested, come by 
Chan-chan's room. I'll be waiting for you.

Afterward, thanks to the Umamusume who 
caught wind of the rumors, the carrots 
seemed to disappear in the blink of an 
eye.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Third prize...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: One carrot. Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What should I do~? I could make it today's 
dinner, or...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what do you think? Miss Shirayuki 
Pyonko.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's delicious, is it? I see.

text_block_list.name: Zookeeper
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, she's totally absorbed in eating 
it. Thank you, Marchan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It is all right. Machan is happy too.

That day, Aston Machan played with her 
close friend until sundown.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ouch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: A miss, is it? Oh dear, oh my.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still... that's true. Failures are 
actually the easiest things to turn into 
material.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Why not turn it into a 4-koma manga? I'm 
sure it'll help cheer you up.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Beginning: Chan-Mar is thrilled with the 
lottery. Development: Chan-Mar spins the 
raffle wheel.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Twist: what came out of that hole was... 
Resolution: a losing ball! And so, tears 
were wiped away with a tissue.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Now I just feel even sadder.

With heavy, sorrowful footsteps, Aston 
Machan set off on her way home...
